module: Career branch level and skill milestones. For each non-"isInDevelopment" branch of career_branches.getSortedBranches(), creates a branch_<id> milestone whose tiers are the levels (requiredValue). Branches give a majorLinear reward and also appear in the general filter; skills (isSkill) give a minorLinear reward. Notifies the player when the next level's threshold is reached.
notes: In onPlayerAttributesChanged, `return` is used when the changed attribute has no milestone: the following attributes of the change table are then not processed (probably `goto continue` was intended).
Triggers the onBranchTierReached(branchKey, step+1) hook when a tier is reached.
Icons per parent branch: motorsport raceFlag, labourer deliveryTruckArrows, specialized carChase01, adventurer jump.
If the branch has no color, it takes that of its parent branch.

onGeneralMilestonesCollect.desc: Hook: adds to milestonesList one milestone per branch/skill and creates its save data if absent.

onGeneralMilestonesSetupCallbacks.desc: Hook: sets the next notification target of each branch milestone.

setNotificationTarget.desc: Computes the target of the next tier to notify (notificationStep + 1) and stores it in milestoneConfig._target; does nothing if all tiers are notified.

onPlayerAttributesChanged.desc: Hook: when a branch attribute increases and exceeds the target, triggers onBranchTierReached, shows the milestone toast, advances notificationStep and recomputes the target.
